name: Roll Player

categories.label: Attribute Goal stars
categories.labelVi: Sao từ mục tiêu thuộc tính
categories.hint: Total stars for the 6 Attribute Rows that meet the Class goal (exact number, range, or N+ after race/weapon adjustments).

categories.label: Class-color dice
categories.hint: 1 star per die on your sheet matching your Class color.

categories.label: Alignment card
categories.hint: Add or subtract the stars under your Alignment token.

categories.label: Armor sets
categories.hint: Per set (Chain/Leather/Mystic): stars printed on cards for set size, +1 if set matches your Class color.

categories.label: Trait cards
categories.hint: Sum stars from all Trait cards.

tiebreakers.description: Fewest dice in your Class color on your sheet

notes: family: set-collection. Reputation Stars are only scored at game end. Game ends after the round in which all players have filled every Attribute Row. Armor, Trait and Attribute Goal values are printed on cards, so they are entered as totals. Solo mode (not modelled): scoring identical plus 1 star per 8 Gold; rating Luminary 30-33, True Hero/Clan Leader higher, NPC <=21. Expansions not modelled.

sources.title: Roll Player Rulebook (Thunderworks Games)
